userDirection: Use the hover-bike ride as inspiration especially for Lisan storyboard. No adoption of the pictured rider as a character.
visualObservations: Weathered cream/brown retro-futurist motorcycle-like hover vehicle with angular front fairing, windshield, two round headlights and luggage-like side blocks.
Three visible blue/pink exhaust-like plumes under/along the vehicle; complete propulsion layout and hidden geometry are unknown.
Rider in cream desert clothing leans forward with hands at the handlebar.
Sand dunes, worn building ruins, a vehicle shadow and a dust-like trail. A pause control suggests a video viewer, but the screenshot alone does not establish actual motion.

identityReferences.rules: Keep Lisan face, natural teeth default, AL/GAIB and neck art from own references; tan stillsuit/black cloak/gold chain from own wardrobe. Optional grill is separate. Breather when selected remains attached throughout; no smoking. Do not copy pictured rider identity or clothing.

shotIdeas.title: Crossing the ruins
shotIdeas.proposal: Wide establishing view: Lisan rides a low hover vehicle past a dune and ruined outpost. One clear travel direction; reveal scale and destination.

shotIdeas.title: The ride
shotIdeas.proposal: Low front three-quarter tracking view, inspired by the vehicle silhouette and twin headlights. Keep handlebars, hands, legs, lamps and thrusters stable; use restrained sand trail and consistent shadow.

shotIdeas.title: Arrival at the next threshold
shotIdeas.proposal: Vehicle slows beside a landmark; Lisan remains seated and looks toward his next objective. End before dismounting so that a new physical action can be designed separately.

workflowBasis.scope: Use the existing official native LTX-2.5 image-to-video route only as a recipe candidate. The prior Hon motion test does not validate this vehicle or Lisan. Current Cloud preflight and a reviewed project-owned starting frame are still required.
